title: AggregatedSignal
description: V2: cross-sectional ranking of the universe by predicted RELATIVE strength (market-neutral). Output of the ML decision model (early fusion over feature_bundle); input to risk_manager. Replaces the old late-fusion buy/hold/sell aggregate. NOT a per-ticker trade command.

score.description: Relative-strength score; higher = expected to outperform the universe.

expected_relative_return.description: Optional expected return vs universe/index over the horizon.

leg.description: Intended portfolio leg (top-k long / bottom-k short / middle flat).

market_neutral.description: True if long and short legs are intended to be balanced (beta-neutral).
